title: What is the 2025 Word of the Year?
speaker: Tom Wilkinson

sentences.en: The Collins Dictionary Word of the Year is… Vibe Coding!
sentences.zh: 《柯林斯词典》的年度词汇是……氛围编程！

sentences.en: In this Thinking in English episode, I’m going to define and explain the term vibe coding and talk about why it was chosen as the W ord of the Year by Collins Dictionary.
sentences.zh: 在本期《Thinking in English》节目中，我将定义并解释“氛围编程”这个词，并探讨它为什么被《柯林斯词典》选为年度词汇。

sentences.en: I’ll also discuss some of the other contenders and runners up for the 2025 Word of the Year, including Broligarchy, Task Masking, and Micro-Retirement.
sentences.zh: 我还将讨论2025年年度词汇的其他候选词和入围词，包括“富豪兄弟会”、“任务伪装”和“微退休”。

sentences.en: These are interesting words and are connected to some fascinating changes and problems in modern society!
sentences.zh: 这些都是有趣的词汇，并且与现代社会中一些迷人的变化和问题息息相关！

sentences.en: Every year, dictionaries choose a single word or phrase as their “word of the year”.
sentences.zh: 每年，各大词典都会选择一个单词或短语作为他们的“年度词汇”。

sentences.en: This word attempts to capture the mood, trends and changes in our society.
sentences.zh: 这个词试图捕捉我们社会的士气、趋势和变化。

sentences.en: It is often a reflection of what people have been talking about, worrying about and shaping their lives around.
sentences.zh: 它通常反映了人们一直在谈论、担忧以及围绕其塑造生活的事情。

sentences.en: This is actually the fifth year I’ve made a Word of the Year episode here on Thinking in English, and it’s always one of my favorites to record.
sentences.zh: 这实际上是我在《Thinking in English》制作年度词汇节目的第五个年头，而且这始终是我最喜欢录制的节目之一。

sentences.en: In the past I’ve talked about Brat, Kakistocracy, AI, Permacrisis and NFTs in these episodes.
sentences.zh: 在过去的这些节目中，我探讨过 Brat、官僚劣政、人工智能、永久危机和NFT。

sentences.en: Now, the Word of the Year isn’t necessarily the most common or popular word.
sentences.zh: 现在，年度词汇不一定是最新潮或最受欢迎的词。

sentences.en: You might not have even heard of it before.
sentences.zh: 你甚至可能以前都没听说过它。

sentences.en: Instead, it’s chosen because it represents the spirit of the year.
sentences.zh: 相反，它的入选是因为它代表了这一年的精神。

sentences.en: And this year, Collins Dictionary has chosen a term that reflects our growing relationship with artificial intelligence: Vibe Coding.
sentences.zh: 而今年，《柯林斯词典》选择了一个反映我们与人工智能日益紧密关系的术语：氛围编程。

sentences.en: So what exactly is vibe coding? According to Collins, vibe coding means using artificial intelligence prompted by natural language to write computer code.
sentences.zh: 那么究竟什么是氛围编程呢？根据《柯林斯词典》的解释，氛围编程是指使用自然语言提示人工智能来编写计算机代码。

sentences.en: That’s a little confusing, so in simpler terms, it’s when you tell an AI assistant what you want it to do, instead of writing the computer code yourself line by line.
sentences.zh: 这听起来有点让人迷惑，所以用更简单的话来说，就是你告诉AI助手你想让它做什么，而不是自己一行一行地编写计算机代码。

sentences.en: You describe the goal or the vibe of what you want to create, and the AI takes care of all of the technical details, all of the actual work.
sentences.zh: 你描述你想要创作的东西的目标或氛围，然后AI会处理所有的技术细节和实际工作。

sentences.en: This term was coined, created, by Andrej Karpathy.
sentences.zh: 这个词是由安德烈·卡帕西（Andrej Karpathy）创造并提出的。

sentences.en: He is a well-known AI researcher and one of the pioneers behind modern machine learning tools.
sentences.zh: 他是一位知名的人工智能研究员，也是现代机器学习工具背后的先驱之一。

sentences.en: He used the phrase to describe how people and companies are moving away from traditional computer programming.
sentences.zh: 他用这个短语来描述人们和公司如何逐渐放弃传统的计算机编程。

sentences.en: Before the recent growth of AI, to create a computer program, you needed to carefully plan and write code yourself.
sentences.zh: 在人工智能最近发展之前，要创建一个计算机程序，你需要自己仔细规划并编写代码。

sentences.en: Now you can just ask AI to create something for you.
sentences.zh: 现在你只需要让AI为你创作一些东西。

sentences.en: It’s “programming by vibes, not variables”.
sentences.zh: 这就是“通过氛围编程，而不是变量”。

sentences.en: Instead of learning complex coding languages, you can now just use natural, everyday English or any other language to tell an AI, “make a simple website”, “design a chatbot”, or “create an app that tracks my expenses”.
sentences.zh: 你不再需要学习复杂的编程语言，现在只需使用自然的、日常的英语或其他语言告诉AI：“做一个简单的网页”、“设计一个聊天机器人”或“创建一个追踪我开销的应用”。

sentences.en: Actually, I have personally experimented with this.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我自己也亲自尝试过这个。

sentences.en: I can’t code, but I have created some apps and tools online using “vibe coding”.
sentences.zh: 我不会写代码，但我已经通过“氛围编程”在网上创建了一些应用和小工具。

sentences.en: I have used a website called Replit and also the AI site Claude to create applications.
sentences.zh: 我曾使用过一个叫做Replit的网站以及AI网站Claude来创建应用程序。

sentences.en: I’ve made a flashcard review app for when I was learning to drive, and I made some templates for potential Thinking in English projects.
sentences.zh: 在我学开车时，我制作了一个抽认卡复习应用，我还为《Thinking in English》潜在的项目制作了一些模板。

sentences.en: All I had to do was ask the AI tools to create something.
sentences.zh: 我所需要做的就是让AI工具去创造一些东西。

sentences.en: I actually made a basic IELTS study tool for a Thinking in English Patreon subscriber.
sentences.zh: 我甚至为《Thinking in English》的一位Patreon订阅者制作了一个基础的雅思学习工具。

sentences.en: It would just generate random IELTS style writing prompts every day, and I made it using Claude.
sentences.zh: 它每天只会生成随机的雅思风格写作提示，而我是用Claude制作的。

sentences.en: It took about five minutes and three or four messages with the AI.
sentences.zh: 这大约只花了五分钟，和AI发了三四条消息。

sentences.en: That’s all it took to create a working app.
sentences.zh: 创建一个能运行的应用只需要这些时间。

sentences.en: I think vibe coding says a lot about how society is changing.
sentences.zh: 我认为氛围编程在很大程度上说明了社会的变革。

sentences.en: We are now much more comfortable with artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 我们现在对人工智能感到更加适应和自在了。

sentences.en: It is part of many people’s daily lives.
sentences.zh: 它是许多人日常生活的一部分。

sentences.en: It’s part of my daily life. At the same time, we want things to be quick and easy to use, and maybe we now care a little less about technical precision.
sentences.zh: 它也是我日常生活的一部分。与此同时，我们希望事物能快速且易于使用，也许我们现在对技术精确度的关注有所减少。

sentences.en: Also, it raises some important questions.
sentences.zh: 此外，这也引发了一些重要的问题。

sentences.en: Are we becoming more creative? Is AI helping us to unlock new ideas and possibilities?
sentences.zh: 我们变得更有创造力了吗？人工智能是否在帮助我们开启新的想法和可能性？

sentences.en: Or are we becoming more dependent on machines to do the thinking for us?
sentences.zh: 还是说我们变得更加依赖机器来替我们思考？

sentences.en: What happens to skills like problem solving, logic, patience, when technology can instantly “vibe” the result we want?
sentences.zh: 当科技能够瞬间“凭氛围”给出我们想要的结果时，诸如解决问题、逻辑、耐心这样的技能会变成什么样？

sentences.en: You can see vibe coding in action. Tools like ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, and Replit, which I mentioned earlier, can write functioning code, design websites, and generate complex scripts based on simple written prompts.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到实际运行中的氛围编程。像ChatGPT、GitHub Copilot以及我刚才提到的Replit这样的工具，可以根据简单的文字提示编写出能运行的代码、设计网站并生成复杂的脚本。

sentences.en: You don’t need any technical skills. You just need to know how to communicate with AI.
sentences.zh: 你不需要任何技术技能。你只需要知道如何与AI沟通。

sentences.en: While “vibe coding” took the top spot as Collin’s 2025 Word of the Year, the short list of runners up also says a lot about the state of our world right now.
sentences.zh: 虽然“氛围编程”夺得了柯林斯2025年度词汇的桂冠，但入围短名单也充分说明了我们目前世界的现状。

sentences.en: In total, Collins highlighted 10 words and phrases this year.
sentences.zh: 今年，柯林斯总共精选了10个单词和短语。

sentences.en: In the rest of this episode, I’ll look at four more of these terms, and explain their context and meaning.
sentences.zh: 在本期节目的剩余部分，我将探讨其中另外四个术语，并解释它们的背景和含义。

sentences.en: On Friday, I’ll release a Thinking in English Bonus Episode on Patreon, which will cover the other five terms.
sentences.zh: 周五，我将在Patreon上发布一期《Thinking in English》的额外福利节目，其中将涵盖另外五个术语。

sentences.en: So if you’re interested, make sure to become a Patreon subscriber.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你感兴趣，请务必成为Patreon订阅者。

sentences.en: The link is in the description. The first runner up to Collins dictionary Word of the Year is “task masking”.
sentences.zh: 链接就在简介里。柯林斯词典年度词汇的第一个入围者是“任务伪装”。

sentences.en: While you may not have heard of the term “task masking” before, I’m sure many of you have been guilty of task masking at some point during your careers.
sentences.zh: 虽然你以前可能没听说过“任务伪装”这个词，但我确信你们中的许多人在职业生涯的某个阶段都曾犯过任务伪装的毛病。

sentences.en: Task masking is the act of pretending to be busy at work.
sentences.zh: 任务伪装就是在工作时假装很忙的行为。

sentences.en: There are many ways you can do this. You could schedule unnecessary meetings, work on meaningless documents.
sentences.zh: 你可以通过多种方式做到这一点。你可以安排不必要的会议，处理毫无意义的文件。

sentences.en: Or if you work from home, constantly move your computer mouse around, so your online status says “Active”.
sentences.zh: 或者如果你在家办公，就不断地晃动电脑鼠标，这样你的在线状态就会显示为“在线”。

sentences.en: It’s a way of masking, covering, your true level of productivity.
sentences.zh: 这是一种掩盖、遮掩你真实生产力水平的方式。

sentences.en: Hence the name task masking. This term has become relevant and popular in 2025 as more companies stopped working from home and moved back to return to office work or hybrid work.
sentences.zh: 因此得名任务伪装。随着越来越多的公司停止在家办公并重新回到办公室上班或实行混合办公，这个词在2025年变得相关且流行起来。

sentences.en: After years of remote work and flexible schedules, many employees have now been forced back into offices.
sentences.zh: 经过多年的远程办公和灵活时间安排后，许多员工现在被迫重返办公室。

sentences.en: In many companies, physical presence, you being in the office, is for some reason more valuable than the actual results you produce.
sentences.zh: 在许多公司里，实体出勤——也就是你在办公室里——出于某种原因比你实际产出的结果更有价值。

sentences.en: Task masking is, in a way, a quiet protest against returning to the office.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，任务伪装是对重返办公室的一种无声抗议。

sentences.en: It’s similar to quiet quitting, which was a word I discussed in 2022 I think, describing workers doing the bare minimum to keep their jobs.
sentences.zh: 这类似于“静默辞职”（quiet quitting），这是我记得在2022年讨论过的一个词，用来描述员工只做维持工作所需的最低限度的事情。

sentences.en: In my opinion, one of the biggest causes of task masking is companies that focus on activity instead of output.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，任务伪装的最大诱因之一就是那些只看重活动量而不看重产出的公司。

sentences.en: If a company thinks the amount of time an employee works, or their activity, is the most important thing, I think it is therefore natural for people to fill any extra time they have by looking busy.
sentences.zh: 如果一家公司认为员工工作的时间长度或其活动量是最重要的，那么我认为人们用看起来很忙的方式来填补任何额外的时间就是很自然的。

sentences.en: If your company rewards activity, then you are incentivized not to produce work, but to look busy.
sentences.zh: 如果你的公司奖励忙碌的表象，那么你受到的激励就不是去产出工作，而是让自己看起来很忙。

sentences.en: In fact, I have friends who complain that their colleagues, who are objectively worse at their jobs, have been promoted because they seem to always be working hard.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我有一些朋友抱怨说，他们那些客观上工作表现更差的同事却得到了晋升，因为他们看起来总是在努力工作。

sentences.en: They seem to be sending emails all day, always in important calls, and very active.
sentences.zh: 他们看起来一整天都在发邮件，总是在开重要的电话会议，而且非常活跃。

sentences.en: However, the actual work they do is similar to or worse than every other employee.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们实际做的工作与其他员工相似甚至更糟。

sentences.en: They just look busier. They just look like they are working harder.
sentences.zh: 他们只是看起来更忙。他们只是看起来更努力。

sentences.en: So basically task masking is looking busy, rather than actually being busy.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，任务伪装就是装忙，而不是真正地忙碌。

sentences.en: Next up is probably my favorite contender for the Word of the Year, “broligarchy”.
sentences.zh: 接下来可能是今年年度词汇中我最喜欢的候选词：“富豪兄弟会”（broligarchy）。

sentences.en: As a former political science student, I enjoy any political word in these lists, and broligarchy is a great one.
sentences.zh: 作为前政治学专业学生，我喜欢这些列表中的任何政治词汇，“富豪兄弟会”就是一个绝佳的词。

sentences.en: It’s a blend of “bro” (or “broism”) and “oligarchy”.
sentences.zh: 它是“兄弟”（bro）或“兄弟主义”（broism）与“寡头政治”（oligarchy）的混合词。

sentences.en: “Bro” is an informal term for a man, which originally came from brother.
sentences.zh: “Bro”是一个指代男性的非正式词汇，最初源自兄弟（brother）。

sentences.en: Bro is often used to describe confident or privileged young men who share a similar culture.
sentences.zh: Bro常用来形容那些有着相似文化的自信或享有特权的年轻男性。

sentences.en: We talk about gym bros, young men who go to the gym together.
sentences.zh: 我们常说健身兄弟（gym bros），也就是一起去健身房的年轻男性。

sentences.en: And in this situation, tech bros, young men working in the tech industry, often in Silicon Valley.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，则是科技兄弟（tech bros），也就是在科技行业工作、通常在硅谷的年轻男性。

sentences.en: Oligarchy is a political system where power and control are held by a small, wealthy, and elite group of people.
sentences.zh: 寡头政治是一种权力和控制权掌握在少数富有且精英阶层手中的政治体制。

sentences.en: So “broligarchy” is a blend of “bro” and “oligarchy”.
sentences.zh: 所以“富豪兄弟会”（broligarchy）就是“兄弟”和“寡头政治”的结合体。

sentences.en: In 2025, it was used to refer to a small, powerful group of tech billionaires who wield huge political influence.
sentences.zh: 在2025年，它被用来指代一小撮拥有巨大政治影响力的权势滔天的科技亿万富翁。

sentences.en: The presence of broligarchs in the USA was made clear in January 2025.
sentences.zh: 2025年1月，富豪兄弟在美国的存在感变得清晰可见。

sentences.en: As Donald Trump was inaugurated as the president of the USA in January, the people sat right behind him, in front of the world’s media, in the best seats, were tech billionaires.
sentences.zh: 1月唐纳德·特朗普就任美国总统时，坐在他身后、面对全球媒体、坐在最好位置上的人正是科技亿万富翁们。

sentences.en: There was Elon Musk of Tesla, Mark Zuckerberg from Meta, Sundar Pichai from Google, and Amazon’s Jeff Bezos.
sentences.zh: 其中包括特斯拉的埃隆·马斯克、Meta的马克·扎克伯格、谷歌的桑达尔·皮查伊以及亚马逊的杰夫·贝佐斯。

sentences.en: These men own or control companies that shape everything from space exploration and AI development to the media.
sentences.zh: 这些人拥有或控制着塑造从太空探索、人工智能发展到媒体等各个领域的公司。

sentences.en: And in recent years, they have become a bigger presence in politics, society, and government policy.
sentences.zh: 近年来，他们在政治、社会和政府政策中占据了越来越重的分量。

sentences.en: The best example of this is Elon Musk, who became one of the biggest political funders in history during the US election in 2024, and then went on to work for the US government for half of 2025.
sentences.zh: 最好的例子就是埃隆·马斯克，他在2024年美国大选期间成为了历史上最大的政治金主之一，随后在2025年的一半时间里为美国政府工作。

sentences.en: These broligarchs own media companies, social media platforms, newspapers, and other communication tools.
sentences.zh: 这些富豪兄弟拥有媒体公司、社交媒体平台、报纸和其他通信工具。

sentences.en: They donate money to politicians. They are on friendly terms with influential government figures.
sentences.zh: 他们向政治家捐款。他们与有影响力的政府人物保持着友好的关系。

sentences.en: The term broligarchy reflects a growing unease with how much power these individuals hold.
sentences.zh: “富豪兄弟会”这个词反映了人们对这些个人所掌握权力的日益不安。

sentences.en: How much power people like Mark Zuckerberg or Elon Musk or Jeff Bezos has.
sentences.zh: 像马克·扎克伯格、埃隆·马斯克或杰夫·贝佐斯这样的人拥有多大的权力。

sentences.en: They’re not elected officials, but they can influence elections.
sentences.zh: 他们不是民选官员，但他们可以影响选举。

sentences.en: They can influence the economy. And they can influence global conversations.
sentences.zh: 他们可以影响经济。他们可以影响全球对话。

sentences.en: Elon Musk owns Twitter. He can influence free speech and technology.
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克拥有推特（Twitter）。他可以影响言论自由和技术。

sentences.en: Mark Zuckerberg owns Instagram and WhatsApp and Facebook.
sentences.zh: 马克·扎克伯格拥有Instagram、WhatsApp和Facebook。

sentences.en: And importantly, broligarchy is a form of oligarchy.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，“富豪兄弟会”是一种寡头政治的形式。

sentences.en: In an oligarchy, the oligarchs are not using their power and influence for the good of all people, but to increase their own power and their own money.
sentences.zh: 在寡头政治中，寡头们并没有将他们的权力和影响力用于造福所有人，而是用来增加他们自己的权力和金钱。

sentences.en: In short, broligarchy highlights the blurred lines, the burred division, between tech companies and politics, especially in the USA.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，“富豪兄弟会”凸显了科技公司与政治之间日益模糊的界限和分歧，尤其是在美国。

sentences.en: And many people are worried that Silicon Valley’s Bros might now be running more than just their companies.
sentences.zh: 许多人担心硅谷的兄弟们现在管理的不止是他们的公司了。

sentences.en: The next term on the list is HENRY. HENRY is an acronym, which is a type of abbreviation formed from the initial letters of each word.
sentences.zh: 列表中的下一个词是HENRY。HENRY是一个首字母缩略词，这是一种由每个单词的首字母组成的缩写形式。

sentences.en: So it stands for High Earner, Not Rich Yet.
sentences.zh: 因此它代表高收入却尚未富裕（High Earner, Not Rich Yet）。

sentences.en: HENRY. HENRY describes people who make good money, often great money with very high salaries, but they still don’t feel financially secure.
sentences.zh: HENRY。HENRY描述的是那些收入很高、通常拿着极高薪水，但仍旧感觉不到财务安全感的人。

sentences.en: They are high earners. They earn a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 他们是高收入者。他们赚很多钱。

sentences.en: But they don’t feel or think they are rich yet.
sentences.zh: 但他们并不觉得自己已经富有了。

sentences.en: Hence, HENRY… High Earner Not Rich Yet. Most often HENRYs are professionals working in corporate careers in their 20s, 30s, and 40s.
sentences.zh: 因此叫做HENRY……高收入却尚未富裕。通常HENRY是二十多岁、三十多岁和四十多岁在企业界工作的专业人士。

sentences.en: Despite earning far more than the average person, they feel trapped or limited in their attempts to become truly rich.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们的收入远超普通人，但在试图真正富裕的过程中，他们感到受困或受限。

sentences.en: Usually this is due to high living costs, student debt, and the social pressure to have or maintain or keep an expensive lifestyle.
sentences.zh: 通常这是由于高昂的生活成本、学生贷款以及拥有、维持或保持昂贵生活方式的社会压力造成的。

sentences.en: Of course a HENRY can afford to go out for dinner, travel, or subscribe to Netflix or the Thinking in English Patreon.
sentences.zh: 当然，一个HENRY负担得起外出用餐、旅游、或者订阅Netflix或《Thinking in English》的Patreon。

sentences.en: But maybe they’re not building real wealth.
sentences.zh: 但也许他们并没有在积累真正的财富。

sentences.en: Wealth in the terms of buying numerous properties or having a massive pension fund.
sentences.zh: 这里所说的财富是指购买多处房产或拥有庞大的养老金基金。

sentences.en: Part of the reason for this is that the high paying jobs are often located in incredibly expensive places.
sentences.zh: 部分原因在于，高薪工作通常位于生活成本极其高昂的地方。

sentences.en: Think about London or San Francisco or New York.
sentences.zh: 想想伦敦、旧金山或纽约。

sentences.en: I have friends who might be considered HENRY’s.
sentences.zh: 我有些朋友可能会被认为是HENRY。

sentences.en: They live in London and San Francisco and they have great salaries, but they have to pay an incredibly high monthly rent.
sentences.zh: 他们住在伦敦和旧金山，拿着高薪，但他们必须支付极其高昂的月租。

sentences.en: In fact, I know someone in San Francisco who earns well, but pays 20 times more monthly rent than I do where I currently live.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我认识一个在旧金山的人，他收入不错，但支付的月租金是我目前居住地方的20倍。

sentences.en: Their salary’s not 20 times higher than mine.
sentences.zh: 他的薪水可没有比我高20倍。

sentences.en: Also, high earners often go to university.
sentences.zh: 此外，高收入者通常都上过大学。

sentences.en: Perhaps they went to law school or medical school, or a graduate school, which in many countries leads to a high level of debt.
sentences.zh: 也许他们读过法学院、医学院或研究生院，这在许多国家会导致高额的债务。

sentences.en: You now find many people with great jobs who are in a lot of debt.
sentences.zh: 你现在可以发现很多拥有好工作却身负巨债的人。

sentences.en: Maybe they have a mortgage, maybe they finance their car, they have to pay back their graduate school every month.
sentences.zh: 也许他们有房贷，也许他们贷款买车，他们每个月必须偿还研究生院的贷款。

sentences.en: Also the tax systems, which are popular in most countries, tend to target work rather than wealth.
sentences.zh: 此外，大多数国家普遍实行的税收制度往往针对劳动所得而不是财富本身。

sentences.en: Basically, most countries tax people with relatively high salaries at relatively high tax rates.
sentences.zh: 基本上，大多数国家对相对高薪的人征收相对较高的税率。

sentences.en: But sometimes they have much lower tax rates on things like bank interest or loans or dividends, which is how really rich people make their money.
sentences.zh: 但有时它们对银行利息、贷款或股息等东西征收低得多的税率，而这正是真正富有的人赚钱的方式。

sentences.en: The UK, for example, has a tax trap that affects people earning between a £100,000 and £125,000.
sentences.zh: 例如，英国有一个税收陷阱，影响着收入在10万到12.5万英镑之间的人。

sentences.en: This would probably be considered HENRY level in the UK.
sentences.zh: 在英国，这大概会被认为是HENRY的水平。

sentences.en: For some complicated reason, people earning between a £100,000 and £125,000 are subject to the highest level of tax in the UK.
sentences.zh: 由于某些复杂的原因，收入在10万到12.5万英镑之间的人在英国要缴纳最高级别的税。

sentences.en: Also for people with children in the UK, earning a high salary means you lose access to some support services for children.
sentences.zh: 同样，对于在英国有孩子的家庭来说，获得高薪意味着你将失去获得某些儿童抚养支持服务的资格。

sentences.en: So as people start earning a higher salary, they quickly find that they have to pay more out of pocket.
sentences.zh: 因此，当人们开始赚取更高的薪水时，他们很快就会发现自己必须掏更多的腰包。

sentences.en: They have to pay for more things. The concept of a HENRY, a High Earner, Not Rich Yet, isn’t a new thing, but it’s becoming increasingly relevant around the world, I think.
sentences.zh: 他们必须为更多事情付费。HENRY的概念——高收入却尚未富裕——并不是什么新鲜事，但我认为它在世界各地变得越来越受关注。

sentences.en: Things like inflation, rising house prices and the cost of living continues to rise around the world.
sentences.zh: 通货膨胀、不断上涨的房价和生活成本继续在全球范围内上升。

sentences.en: And it’s making people who traditionally would be considered to be rich, with great salaries, struggle.
sentences.zh: 这使得那些传统上被认为很富裕、拿着丰厚薪水的人也在挣扎。

sentences.en: I think this is why HENRY has been chosen as one of Collins Words of the Year.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是为什么HENRY会被选为柯林斯年度词汇之一的原因。

sentences.en: Finally, I want to talk about micro- retirement.
sentences.zh: 最后，我想谈谈微退休（micro-retirement）。

sentences.en: Micro- retirement is one of the more hopeful and positive entries on Collins Word of the Year shortlist.
sentences.zh: 微退休是柯林斯年度词汇短名单中比较充满希望和积极意义的词条之一。

sentences.en: A micro- retirement is when people take short breaks between jobs or careers to travel, rest, or maybe focus on personal growth.
sentences.zh: 微退休是指人们在工作或职业之间短暂休息，去旅行、休息或专注于个人成长。

sentences.en: They do this instead of waiting until they’re in their 60s or 70s and they retire to enjoy their life.
sentences.zh: 他们这样做，而不是一直等到六七十岁退休再去享受生活。

sentences.en: It’s inspired by the idea that traditional retirement may never come.
sentences.zh: 它的灵感来自于传统的退休可能永远不会到来的想法。

sentences.en: Especially for younger people, especially for younger generations facing an uncertain economic future, there is a chance that you will die before you retire.
sentences.zh: 特别是对年轻人而言，特别是对于面临不确定经济未来的年轻一代来说，你可能在退休前就去世了。

sentences.en: There is a chance that you will become too ill to enjoy your retirement.
sentences.zh: 你可能生病到无法享受退休生活的程度。

sentences.en: Or the sad reality is that many people may never be able to afford to retire or be able to retire in the way that they think they will be able to.
sentences.zh: 或者一个悲惨的现实是，许多人可能永远负担不起退休的费用，或者无法以他们想象中的方式退休。

sentences.en: Governments are struggling with pension funds.
sentences.zh: 各国政府都在艰难应对养老金基金的问题。

sentences.en: Governments are raising the pension ages across the world.
sentences.zh: 世界各地的政府都在提高退休年龄。

sentences.en: Maybe in the future you won’t be able to retire, at least not in the way that you think you can now.
sentences.zh: 也许在未来你将无法退休，至少无法以你现在想象的方式退休。

sentences.en: So a micro- retirement is a solution to this.
sentences.zh: 因此微退休就是对此的一个解决方案。

sentences.en: Rather than leaving all of the joy and all of the traveling until you end your working life, many people are now choosing to do these things right now.
sentences.zh: 与其把所有的快乐和旅行都留到工作生涯结束时，许多人现在选择立刻去做这些事情。

sentences.en: And I think this trend is a response to burnout and modern working cultures.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种趋势是对职业倦怠和现代工作文化的一种回应。

sentences.en: Also, many people are now aware that health and happiness and a balance in your life matters just as much as your career success.
sentences.zh: 此外，许多人现在意识到健康、快乐和生活平衡与你的职业成功同样重要。

sentences.en: In fact, I think it’s more important than career success.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我认为它比职业成功更重要。

sentences.en: And I have long been a proponent amongst my friends of taking time out and of doing something a little bit different.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，我在朋友当中一直是一直主张腾出时间做点完全不同事情的支持者。

sentences.en: I remember when I was 23 and I was about to go to Taiwan, a friend of mine from high school said to me, “Why?
sentences.zh: 我记得当我23岁准备去台湾时，我的一位高中朋友对我说：“为什么？”

sentences.en: Why are you going abroad again? Why don’t you go and get a proper job?
sentences.zh: “你为什么又要出国？你为什么不去找一份正经的工作？”

sentences.en: Why don’t you go and have a real career?”
sentences.zh: “你为什么不去追求一个真正的职业呢？”

sentences.en: And I said, “Well, I’m 23. In the UK, I’d probably be working until I was 70.
sentences.zh: 我说：“嗯，我23岁。在英国，我大概要工作到70岁。”

sentences.en: One year, six months out studying in Taiwan, learning a little bit of Chinese, in the long term is not going to really harm my career, and it will be something nice to look back on when I’m in my retirement years.”
sentences.zh: 在台湾学习一年、六个月，学点中文，从长远来看对我的职业生涯真的不会有什么损害，而且当我老了退休时，这也是一件值得回头细细品味的美好事情。”

sentences.en: That was the 2025 Collins Dictionary Word of the Year, vibe coding and some other fascinating terms from the past 12 months.
sentences.zh: 以上就是2025年《柯林斯词典》年度词汇、氛围编程以及过去12个月中其他一些迷人的术语。

sentences.en: I found these terms interesting. They all reflect something about the modern world.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这些词很有趣。它们都反映了现代世界的某些方面。

sentences.en: They reflected how AI is shaping how we work and create things.
sentences.zh: 它们反映了人工智能如何塑造我们的工作和创造事物的方式。

sentences.en: They also are influenced by our attitudes towards money and power and rest.
sentences.zh: 它们也受到我们对金钱、权力和休息的态度所影响。

sentences.en: Language always evolves. It always changes.
sentences.zh: 语言总是在演变。它总是在变化。

sentences.en: And it’s always affected by society and time.
sentences.zh: 并且它总是受到社会和时代的影响。

sentences.en: And I think each of those Words of the Year demonstrates this.
sentences.zh: 我认为每一个年度词汇都证明了这一点。

sentences.en: Now, I’d love to hear from you. What would your personal word of the year be for 2025?
sentences.zh: 现在，我很想听听你们的看法。你2025年的个人年度词汇会是什么？

sentences.en: What single word sums up your life, your experiences, and your feelings this year?
sentences.zh: 哪个单一的词汇能够总结你今年的生活、经历和感受？
